metadata.question: Did tropospheric nitrogen dioxide (NO2) concentrations over New York City appear higher at 2:00-3:00 pm than at 5:00-6:00 pm local time on August 9, 2023?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: Sentinel-5P TROPOMI for NO2 (tropospheric column) - Date: August 9, 2023 - Location: New York City (approximately -74.0, 40.7) - Time filtering: Need to filter by acquisition time (2-3pm vs 5-6pm local time) - NYC is in EDT (UTC-4) in August, so 2-3pm local = 18-19 UTC, 5-6pm local = 21-22 UTC 2. Masking strategy: - Use quality flag (qa_value >= 0.75) to filter good quality pixels - The question is about NO2 concentrations, not clouds, so mask poor quality data 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Check if images exist for both time periods (C1) - Check if valid pixels exist after masking (C2) - Compare mean NO2 values: if afternoon (2-3pm) > evening (5-6pm), answer A; otherwise B - Validate that results are not null/NaN (C3) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const nyc = ee.Geometry.Point([-74.0, 40.7]).buffer(20000); // 20km buffer around NYC const date = '2023-08-09'; // NYC is EDT (UTC-4) in August // 2-3pm local = 18-19 UTC // 5-6pm local = 21-22 UTC // 2. Data Acquisition const no2Col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2') .filterDate(date, '2023-08-10') .filterBounds(nyc) .select('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density'); const totalImages = no2Col.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Total NO2 images on ${date}: ${totalImages}`); if (totalImages === 0) { console.log("No images found for specified date."); console.log("C1"); return; } // Filter by time (hour of day) const afternoon = no2Col.filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(18, 19, 'hour')); // 2-3pm local const evening = no2Col.filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(21, 22, 'hour')); // 5-6pm local const afternoonSize = afternoon.size().getInfo(); const eveningSize = evening.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Afternoon (2-3pm local/18-19 UTC) images: ${afternoonSize}`); console.log(`Evening (5-6pm local/21-22 UTC) images: ${eveningSize}`); if (afternoonSize === 0 || eveningSize === 0) { console.log("No images found for one or both time periods."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Create composites with quality masking const maskQuality = function(image) { const qa = image.select('qa_value'); const mask = qa.gte(0.75); return image.updateMask(mask); }; const afternoonImg = afternoon.map(maskQuality).mean(); const eveningImg = evening.map(maskQuality).mean(); // 4. Calculate mean NO2 and pixel counts const afternoonStats = afternoonImg.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: nyc, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const eveningStats = eveningImg.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: nyc, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const afternoonMean = afternoonStats.tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density_mean; const afternoonCount = afternoonStats.tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density_count; const eveningMean = eveningStats.tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density_mean; const eveningCount = eveningStats.tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density_count; console.log(`Afternoon NO2: ${afternoonMean?.toExponential(3)} mol/m² (Pixels: ${afternoonCount})`); console.log(`Evening NO2: ${eveningMean?.toExponential(3)} mol/m² (Pixels: ${eveningCount})`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (afternoonCount === 0 || eveningCount === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels after quality masking."); console.log("C2"); return; } if (afternoonMean === null || eveningMean === null || isNaN(afternoonMean) || isNaN(eveningMean)) { console.log("Calculation failed - invalid results."); console.log("C3"); return; } if (afternoonMean > eveningMean) { console.log("Afternoon NO2 concentrations were higher than evening."); console.log("A"); } else { console.log("Afternoon NO2 concentrations were NOT higher than evening."); console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
